name: Tuff Cliff
science_question: Jones et al. place the Tuff Cliff member at the base of the Bright Angel formation: thin, planar layers with pebbles up to 2.5 cm, which may have formed on land or at the edge of a lake, before the lake deepened into the mudstones above. Do these layers record the start of the lake?
tasks: Photograph the outcrop face from about 5 m to show its layering.
Measure the thickness of three layers with a scale bar in the frame.
Look for rounded pebbles (up to about 2.5 cm) in the layers and photograph any you find with a scale bar.
